bootstrap.difference_definition: first minus second; negative favors first

comparison_question: Which HRRR predictor-grid representation gives the most accurate ANN-CSGD probabilities on a common 0.25° MRMS target?

operational_recommendation.label: Recommended default: 0.25° ANN-CSGD
operational_recommendation.summary: The 0.25° system gives the best overall balance of continuous CRPS and threshold-specific Brier skill, including the heavy-rainfall thresholds.

resolutions.label: Native HRRR (~3 km)
resolutions.sampling_method: Nearest native land cell to each 0.25° location

scientific_caveat: This experiment compares predictor-grid representations using a common 0.25° MRMS target and common verification locations. It is not an end-to-end comparison of forecasts verified at different spatial supports.
